title: 第9章 萧腾的实力
slug: 武破九荒全本免费-武破九荒最新章节列表
content_zh:
萧大山从震惊中回归神来，他跳上擂台，高声道：“我宣布，萧叶胜出，进入竞争六强的决赛，坐第六把虎座。”
随着萧大山的话音落下，现场爆发出震天欢呼声，所有人都在呐喊萧叶的名字，满脸的疯狂。
一人战败三百位同辈，这是何等的强悍？这样的壮举，使得场中很多少年热血激荡，崇拜的望着擂台上的萧阳，将其当做偶像。
而参加选婚的少女，恨不得能立刻站在萧叶身边，成为萧叶的伴侣。能成为一个强者的女人，这是她们最期盼与渴望的事情。
“混蛋，他怎么会这么强！”吴媚儿气得直跺脚，对方明明昏迷了三个月，可刚刚醒转，就达到让同辈仰望的层次。
萧叶有些无语的看着台下，然后跃下擂台，迈步走向虎座。
萧腾目光阴沉的望着萧叶，坐在了第六把虎座上。
“我会让你尝试下，什么叫绝望！”萧腾双拳缓缓握紧。
擂台上的萧大山手掌虚按，场中的欢呼声顿时小了下去。
“休息半个时辰后，正式进入决赛。”萧大山说完，便跳下了擂台。
半个时辰的休息时间，实际上是为了从混战中脱颖而出少年准备的，但众人心中都明白，萧叶参加混战，根本没有多少消耗。
但是规矩就是规矩，众人耐下性子，在等待决赛的同时，低声的谈论起来。
“你们说，这次选婚比武的冠军会是谁？”
“我觉得萧叶胜出的可能性很大。啧啧，十五岁的炼体九重巅峰，还真是天才啊。”
“切，萧叶是天才没错。但是其他五人，哪一个是普通角色？”有人不屑道，“比如萧腾，他在使用了蛟蛇血后，实力绝对不会比萧叶差。”
“还有石家村第一天才石波，一身实力达到了炼体九重巅峰，萧叶与他相比，毕竟还嫩了点。”
听到这人的话，众人思索片刻，纷纷点头赞同。
能坐上虎座的，莫不是各大村子最出色的人物，站在青阳镇同辈中的巅峰，身上凝聚着最耀眼的光芒。
萧叶和这些人相比，还是太年轻了点，占据不了丝毫的优势。
很快，半个时辰的时间过去，萧大山走上了擂台。

“呵呵，下面就是让大家最为关注的决赛了，我也不多说废话，我手中有一份决赛的名单，凡是念到名字的人，上来比试。”
萧大山说着，又重新拿出一份名单。
众人屏息，目含期待，最先交手的，会是谁？
“第一场，吴家村的吴大牛，对决石家村的石威。”念完名单，萧大山便走下擂台。
“石威！”
从第四把虎座上站起一位青年，他皮肤黝黑，身躯壮硕如蛮牛，高大的身躯极具视觉压迫感。
他瞪着第三把虎座上的青年道：“听说你是石家村的第二天才，今天就让俺试试，你是不是有那个斤两！”
石威是一位相貌普通的青年，他从虎座上站起，冷笑道：“你这头蠢牛，今天我要把你打得娶不到媳妇！”
“我娶不到媳妇，那我就搞你媳妇！”吴大牛一瞪眼，牛脾气上来了。
两者都是各自村子同辈中的佼佼者，心中自然有股不服输的傲气。
“哈哈，大牛好样的，不愧是吴家村的种！”吴大牛的话，顿时引得哄堂大笑，让台下的少女脸上浮现一缕红霞，白了吴大牛一眼。
紧接着，两人跳上了擂台，在众人的注视下，开始了对决。
“啊！”只见吴大牛嘴中大吼，踩着擂台爆冲向石威，那沉重的步伐将擂台都踩得震动起来。
“这个吴大牛，好强的力量。”萧叶眼前一亮。
擂台上，石威被吴大牛的力量震撼到了，他脚步连踏，躲开了吴大牛的冲击。
两人一个追，一个躲，一时间陷入了僵局。
擂台下的村民齐齐摇头，这样的对决能有什么看头？
“吴老头，听说你们村子的吴大牛天生巨力，如今一见果然不凡啊。”萧天雄赞叹道。
吴狮得意一笑，说道：“那是自然。别看大牛才炼体九重中期的实力，但是力量却却可以和炼体九重巅峰的武者相比。”
“石老头，你们村子的石威输定喽。”

石战的表情却出乎意料的平静，他淡然的喝了一口酒，说道：“石威才炼体九重中期实力，输了也是正常。”
果然没过多久，石威正躲闪之际，被吴大牛一拳砸中右臂，身形停滞了下来。而吴大牛则抓住机会，一阵狂风暴雨似的攻击，将石威砸出了擂台。

content_en:
Xiao Dashan came back to consciousness from the shock. He jumped onto the ring and said loudly: "I declare that Xiao Ye wins and enters the finals of the top six competition, taking the sixth tiger seat."
As Xiao Dashan finished speaking, the scene erupted into cheers, and everyone was shouting Xiao Ye's name with crazy expressions on their faces.
How powerful is it for one person to defeat three hundred of his peers? Such a feat made many young people in the field excited, looking at Henry Zhang in admiration and treating him as an idol.
The girls who participated in the marriage selection wished they could stand beside Xiao Ye immediately and become Xiao Ye's partner. Being able to become a strong woman is what they most expect and desire.
"Asshole, how could he be so strong!" Wu Mei'er stomped her feet angrily. The other person had obviously been in a coma for three months, but he had just woken up and reached a level that made his peers look up to him.
Xiao Ye looked at the audience speechlessly, then jumped off the stage and walked towards the tiger seat.
Xiao Teng looked at Xiao Ye with gloomy eyes and sat on the sixth tiger seat.
"I will let you try, what is despair!" Xiao Teng slowly clenched his fists.
Xiao Dashan on the stage pressed his palms, and the cheers in the arena suddenly died down.
"After half an hour's rest, we officially entered the finals." After Xiao Dashan finished speaking, he jumped off the ring.
The half-hour rest period was actually prepared for the young man to stand out from the melee, but everyone knew that Xiao Ye's participation in the melee did not consume much at all.
But rules are rules, so everyone held their nerve and started talking in low voices while waiting for the final.
"Who do you think will be the winner of this marriage contest?"
"I think Xiao Ye has a high chance of winning. Tsk, tsk, at the peak of the ninth level of body training at the age of fifteen, he is really a genius."
"Yes, Xiao Ye is a genius. But among the other five, which one is an ordinary character?" Someone said disdainfully, "For example, Xiao Teng, after using the snake blood, his strength will definitely not be worse than Xiao Ye."
"There is also Shi Bo, the number one genius in Shijiacun. His strength has reached the peak of the ninth level of body refining. Compared with him, Xiao Ye is still a bit young after all."
After hearing what this man said, everyone thought for a moment and nodded in agreement.
Those who can sit on the Tiger Seat are none other than the most outstanding figures in each major village. They stand at the pinnacle of their peers in Qingyang Town and embody the most dazzling light.
Compared with these people, Xiao Ye is still too young and cannot have the slightest advantage.
Soon, half an hour passed and Xiao Dashan stepped onto the ring.
"Haha, the following is the final that attracts the most attention. I won't talk nonsense. I have a list of finalists in my hand. Anyone whose name comes up can come up and compete."
Xiao Dashan said and took out another list.
Everyone holds their breath and looks forward to it. Who will be the first to fight?
"In the first match, Wu Daniu from Wujiacun will face off against Shi Wei from Shijiacun." After reading the list, Xiao Dashan walked off the ring.
"Shi Wei!"
A young man stood up from the fourth tiger seat. He had dark skin and a body as strong as a bull. His tall body was very visually oppressive.
He glared at the young man on the third tiger seat and said: "I heard that you are the second genius in Shijiacun. Let me try today to see if you have the talent!"
Shi Wei was an ordinary-looking young man. He stood up from the tiger seat and sneered: "You stupid cow, today I will beat you until you can't get a wife!"
"If I can't get a wife, then I'll get your wife!" Wu Daniu glared, his temper rising.
Both of them are the best among their peers in their respective villages, and they naturally have an arrogance in their hearts that refuses to admit defeat.
"Haha, Daniu is so good, he is worthy of being a descendant of Wujia Village!" Wu Daniu's words immediately caused a roar of laughter, causing a wisp of red to appear on the face of the girl in the audience, and giving Wu Daniu a white look.
Immediately afterwards, the two jumped onto the ring and started a duel under the gaze of everyone.
"Ah!" I saw Wu Daniu's big mouthRoar, stepping on the ring and rushing towards Shi Wei, the heavy steps shook the ring.
"This Wu Daniu is so powerful." Xiao Ye's eyes lit up.
In the ring, Shi Wei was shocked by Wu Daniu's strength. He stepped on his feet to avoid Wu Daniu's impact.
The two of them were chasing each other, while the other was hiding, and they were in a deadlock for a while.
The villagers under the ring shook their heads in unison. What's the point of such a duel?
"Old man Wu, I heard that Wu Daniu from your village was born with great strength, and now he is indeed extraordinary." Xiao Tianxiong praised.
Wu Shi smiled proudly and said: "That's natural. Although the strength of a great man is in the middle of the ninth level of body refining, his strength is comparable to that of a warrior at the peak of the ninth level of body refining."
"Old man Shi, the Shiwei of your village will definitely lose."
Shi Zhan's expression was unexpectedly calm. He took a sip of wine calmly and said, "Shi Weicai is only at the middle level of the ninth level of body refining. It's normal for him to lose."
Sure enough, not long after, when Shi Wei was dodging, he was punched in the right arm by Wu Daniu, and his body stagnated. Wu Daniu seized the opportunity and launched a violent storm of attacks, knocking Shi Wei out of the ring.
